question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Calamity
solution:
The correct answer is "**Disaster**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Calamity" means a disastrous event or a catastrophe.**(आपदा)

 
 
• Example: He described drugs as the greatest calamity of the age.
 
 
 
• **Disaster is the synonym of the word Calamity, as it also refers to a sudden event causing great damage or loss.**(महाविपदा)
 
 
• Example: Disaster is a problem that causes huge loss.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "disaster" is the synonym of the word "calamity."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Fortune means a large amount of money or assets.(भाग्य)
 
• Windfall means an unexpected financial gain or a sudden stroke of good luck.(अप्रत्याशित)
 
• Prosperity means the state of being successful or thriving financially.(समृद्धि)
